## Not one of the two required edge workflows
A minimal stand-in so `outcome-sync.json` has somewhere real to POST to without a real CRM dependency (task explicitly says not to introduce one unless already configured). It just echoes what it received back into n8n's execution log — that log entry is the "proof of write" for this demo.

To point at a real CRM later: edit the URL on `outcome-sync.json`'s "POST Mock CRM Sink" node (currently the literal `http://n8n:5678/webhook/mock-crm-sink` — n8n blocks `$env` access in expressions by default, so this is hardcoded rather than read from a container env var) and delete this workflow.
